summary: This bill nullifies specific Executive Orders that mandated COVID-19 vaccines for federal contractors and employees, and prohibits the Secretaries of Labor and Health and Human Services from issuing rules requiring COVID-19 vaccination or testing mandates for employees, including for healthcare providers participating in Medicare and Medicaid.
